known.via: English Wikipedia "Traisental" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A wine district in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, south of Krems. Grüner Veltliner dominates at 64 percent and is made fresh for drinking young. Traisental DAC covers Grüner Veltliner and Riesling.
